SHL player id crosswalk: isa id to athlete uuid

Source: R/shl.R
shl_player_crosswalk.Rd

The SHL has three player id systems: the isa (StatNet) id that play-by-play, box scores and stats tables key on, the platform athlete uuid that rosters and athlete routes key on, and the old ramses_legacy CMS id (athlete-details only). The players_summary table's players{} map is keyed by isa and carries each player's uuid, skaters and goalies alike, so one stats-info call per season gives the whole crosswalk.

Usage

shl_player_crosswalk(season, game_type = "regular")

Arguments

season

Season END year (2026 = 2025/26).

game_type

Game type: "regular", "playoff", "qualdown" or "playin".

Value

A fastRhockey_data tibble, one row per player, with the following columns (the API may add more, after these):

col_nametypedescription
player_idintegerisa (StatNet) player id: the map key. The id play-by-play, box scores and stats tables key on.
athlete_uuidcharacterPlatform athlete uuid (qQ9-... or 10-char form); joins to the athlete routes and the roster. Null where SHL has none, common before about 2005.
first_namecharacterGiven (first) name of the player.
last_namecharacterSurname (family name) of the player.
jersey_numberintegerJersey (shirt) number of the player.
positioncharacterPosition as the players map carries it (F, D, GK or a Swedish label).
shootscharacterShooting side (L / R; Left / Right).
full_namecharacterGiven name and surname.
date_of_birthcharacterDate of birth (YYYY-MM-DD).
nationalitycharacterNationality (ISO country code).
gendercharacterSex of the athlete (male / female).
weightintegerWeight of the player in kilograms.
heightintegerHeight of the player in centimetres.
ep_urlcharacterExternal profile URL of the player (empty in the sample).

Errors

fastRhockey_no_data: layout-info lists no such ssgt, or the table has no rows. fastRhockey_asset_fetch: the fetch failed or the table came back cut.

See also

Other SHL Functions: shl_athlete_career(), shl_athlete_details(), shl_athlete_game_log(), shl_athlete_profile(), shl_athlete_seasons(), shl_boxscore(), shl_game_header(), shl_game_overview(), shl_game_summary(), shl_last_game_day(), shl_layout_info(), shl_next_game_day(), shl_pbp(), shl_player_box(), shl_player_h2h(), shl_post_game_team_stats(), shl_roster(), shl_schedule(), shl_season_filter(), shl_sites(), shl_ssgt_provider(), shl_ssgt_uuid(), shl_standings(), shl_stats_info(), shl_team(), shl_team_played_games(), shl_team_stats(), shl_team_upcoming_games()

Examples

# \donttest{
  xw <- shl_player_crosswalk(2026)
  xw[xw$player_id == 2427, ]
